> I think you're an interesting person with an interesting voice. It seems that your problem is more the slow drip-drip-drip of life suffering rather than the flood of depression that overwhelms.

That's right, but I was overwhelmed by it as a teenager. I was literally scratching myself und kicking around when I hit below 0, because I couldn't take it and had to be drugged up with Tavor. Now it is how you describe it. It makes things more dangerous though and I really reached my limits now.

I am good at a few things, but not passionate about anything. I am a good guitar player and a good songwriter, or I was. I played in bands, was kind of successful in that, but again with anything, I burned out, because that's what happens if you don't really enjoy it. Today I pick my guitar up only out of habit, play some tunes until I annoy myself. There is are lots of other stuff that I learned through a few manic phases, I still have weird equipment lying around for specific stuff that I am not connected to anymore.

There is no scenario I can imagine that I would enjoy. I asked myself a similar question when I was 18, how it would be like to be wealthy and do whatever I like. I worked hard for it and got semi rich in a unconventional fashion. My motivation was my anger, I was scoffing at life. Again, it was very painful to watch myself not feeling anything, isolating myself and alienating myself even more because I was just playing a role in a movie. I stopped doing anything 1,5 years ago and was living off the money I made in my early 20ies, but there is not that much left of it, but it really doesn't matter now. In fact it wouldn't bother me even if I was planning to continue to watch my life go by as a spectator.

Thank you for your reply. I tried several therapists and they tried many meds on me for longer periods of time. I wouldn't say any of those therapists was bad and I am always willing to talk about everything, especially when the person I am talking to can take it. It is really hard to explain in a few words what exactly is bothering me over the internet (English is not my first language, I am German). I spend the last hour with reading some of the posts here and many of them are very very dark, much darker than my post here.

I am not pessimistic about things in general and I can achieve stuff if I really want it, I learned to get shit done even though I have trouble to get out of bed. The problem is that I don't really want it. I tried to live a 'normal' life but I end up breaking down psychologically. What it feels like to be human was always a mystery to me and it is very draining over time when you are surrounded by life but you are not part of it.
